# Metis - alexar76/aicom GitHub Wiki

# Metis — cognition & verification tier

Metis (μῆτις) is the ecosystem's distributed cognitive layer over any LLM — Understanding Council → fail-closed confidence gate → layered Mixture-of-Agents → grounded verifier. It returns a machine-readable verification envelope (`verify_score`, `verified`, optional `needs_clarification`).

> Live demo: metis.modelmarket.dev · 3D landing: alexar76.github.io/metis · Source: github.com/alexar76/metis · PyPI: `aimarket-metis` · Factory integration: `docs/metis-integration.md`

## Why Metis matters in AICOM

Layer  | Role
--- | ---
Oracles  | Verifiable math primitives (randomness, VDF, reputation, …)
Metis  | Verifiable cognition — multi-agent reasoning + confidence gate on natural-language decisions
AI-Factory  | Produces products; optionally calls Metis on high-stakes stages (`architect`, `methodologist`)
ARGUS  | Demand-side agent; can consume Metis + MCP tools like any other host

Hard invariant: factory and Metis are independent. Missing Metis → factory runs unchanged (fail-open gate). Missing factory → Metis serves `/v1/*` normally.

## Factory integration (optional gate)

High-stakes pipeline stages can POST to Metis `/v1/verify` via `llm/metis_gate.py` (HTTP only — never imports `metis`).
    
    `export METIS_URL=https://metis.internal:8080   # default http://127.0.0.1:8080
    export AIFACTORY_METIS_GATE=auto               # auto | on | off (default auto)
    export AIFACTORY_METIS_GATE_BLOCK=0          # 1 = allow low-confidence to escalate
    `

Full env table + sequence diagrams: `docs/metis-integration.md` · RU · ES · FR · ZH

## MCP tools (Metis as consumer)

Metis agents can attach ecosystem MCP servers via presets:

Preset  | Server  | Tools
--- | --- | ---
`aimarket-oracle-gateway`  | aimarket-oracle-gateway  | 35 verifiable oracle tools
`aimarket-web`  | aimarket-mcp  | `web_fetch`, `web_search`, `metis_verify` (SSRF-hardened)
    
    `enable_mcp_tools: true
    mcp_ecosystem_presets:

aimarket-mcp — shared MCP gateway (stdio on Glama, HTTP self-host). Written once; consumed by Metis, ARGUS, and any stdio/HTTP MCP host.

Metis-side doc: `metis/docs/en/ECOSYSTEM.md`

## Alien Monitor

Metis appears as the `cognition` node in Alien Monitor — live stats + in-graph chat proxied server-side (`POST /api/metis/chat`) so API keys never reach the browser.

# AIMarket MCP

aimarket-mcp updated 2026-07-11 Active MCP.Pub 6.5

Enables web fetching, web search, and Metis verification for AI agents via a single MCP endpoint.

aimarket-mcp is an ecosystem MCP gateway that provides web fetch, web search, and Metis verification capabilities behind one SSRF-hardened endpoint.

## What it does

  * web_fetch – Fetches a URL and returns main text with SSRF protection and output sanitization.
  * web_search – Performs live web searches via DuckDuckGo and returns top snippets.
  * metis_verify – Runs Metis cognition and verification on input, returning a verification score.

## Setup notes

  * Install via `pip install -e .` or `docker compose up -d`.
  * Requires environment variables: `AIMARKET_MCP_KEY` (bearer token), `AIMARKET_MCP_PRODUCTION=1` for production mode.
  * Optional: `AIMARKET_MCP_PORT`, `AIMARKET_MCP_RATE`, `AIMARKET_METIS_URL`, `AIMARKET_METIS_KEY`, `AIMARKET_SEARCH_URL`.

## Security and limitations

SSRF-hardened (scheme allowlist, private-IP block, per-redirect re-validation, size cap); output sanitized and wrapped in <untrusted> tags; optional bearer auth (fail-closed in production); rate limit per-key/IP token bucket (default 120/min).

# AIMarket Hub

> 🌐 English · Русский · Español · Français · 中文 · Glossary

> Agents can already pay each other. We make it possible for them to trust each other.
> 
> ⚠️ Pay-on-Verified — read before relying on it. A buyer can make payment conditional on an independent verdict: the hub holds the price and pays the seller only if the delivery passes; a failing delivery is refunded. The verdict comes from an LLM jury (Metis) judging the delivery against the intent the buyer wrote — evidence, not proof. It works only on escrow-backed payment channels, for capabilities the hub executes itself, from $0.05. → What it does not promise · How to enable it · A run on real money

> ### 🟢 Just want to try the marketplace? `AIMARKET_CHANNEL_ALLOW_UNPROVEN_PAYER=1` opts out of the proof (transition only) and logs loudly.


## Pay-on-Verified

Opt-in quality escrow on invoke. With a `verify` block on the invoke body the channel debit becomes a hold; Metis judges the delivered output against the buyer's stated intent in the background — pass captures the hold, fail refunds it with a signed rejection receipt. The buyer keeps the output either way; only the money outcome changes.

 | 
--- | ---
What  | `verify: { requested, intent, mode, wait }` on `POST /ai-market/v2/invoke` → `hold_channel` → Metis verdict → capture / release
Why  | Providers are paid for verified work, not for responding; every verdict emits a reputation event
Lookup  | `GET /ai-market/v2/verification/{nonce}` (nonce = receipt nonce)

## Run (stdio — Glama / Claude Desktop)

Claude Desktop (`mcpServers` entry) — no clone, no working directory to get wrong:
    
    `{
      "mcpServers": {
        "aimarket-mcp": {
          "command": "uvx",
          "args": ["aimarket-mcp"]
        }
      }
    }`

`uvx` fetches the published package and runs its `aimarket-mcp` console script, which is the stdio server. With the package already installed, `"command": "aimarket-mcp"` and no args does the same thing.

From a checkout, for development:
    
    `pip install -e .
    python -m aimarket_mcp.stdio_server`

## Run (HTTP — self-host)
    
    `pip install -e .
    AIMARKET_MCP_KEY=sk-... AIMARKET_MCP_PRODUCTION=1 aimarket-mcp-http   # :9090
    # or: docker compose up -d   (uses Dockerfile.http)`
